profile.summary: watilde is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in npm CLI maintenance, dependency management, and documentation. Their contributions focus on modernizing JavaScript syntax (e.g., replacing `var` with `const`), improving npm’s dependency security (via `npm audit`), and maintaining high-quality documentation using Markdown-based tools. They demonstrate strong familiarity with npm’s internals, semantic versioning, and CI/CD workflows, particularly the migration from Travis CI to GitHub Actions. While their work is primarily backend-focused (npm CLI), their contributions reflect deep technical knowledge of JavaScript best practices and open-source collaboration.

Dependency Management: Version bumps and CI/CD tooling updates
CI/CD & DevOps: Travis CI migration to GitHub Actions
